page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is driven by dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processors operating at 4.0 GHz, configured with 44 physical cores and 88 vCPUs (two threads per core). It includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 105 MB L3 cache. In addition to standard x86_64 extensions, the processor features Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX tile and INT8) and AVX-512 vector execution units, specifically supporting AVX-512 VNNI and BF16 instructions.

Hardware resource capacity is heavily scaled toward enterprise data workloads, providing 3892.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 44.23 GB of memory per core. Local storage is integrated directly via 8590 GB of high-speed SSD disk. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators, relying purely on host CPU execution for general computational and vectorized tasks.

Benchmark evaluations highlight strong parallel throughput and superior memory subsystem bandwidth. Potentially uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 419.61 GB/sec, while write operations attained 181.06 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Compute-intensive multi-threaded tasks performed similarly well, marked by a PassMark CPU score of 94306.2 and a top-tier score of 34697.66 in PassMark database operations. While single-thread benchmarks like stress-ng fall into the median range, multi-core execution demonstrates consistent high-tier scalability across software compilation and encryption.

The instance delivers specialized capability for in-memory systems where extreme memory density and massive local SSD storage negate external network storage latency. Given its dedicated resource allocation, the platform is optimal for large-scale relational and in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, massive caching tiers via Redis, enterprise ETL pipelines, and high-footprint analytical workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 88 dedicated vCPUs (44 physical cores) based on Intel Xeon 8473C processors clocked at 4.0 GHz. Designed for demanding memory-bound workloads, it integrates an extensive 3892.0 GB of system memory (44.23 GB per core) alongside 8590 GB of local SSD storage, operating without discrete GPUs. The underlying hardware incorporates advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and AMX, and achieved top-tier benchmark results in large-block uncached memory read bandwidth (419.61 GB/sec) and database operations. Its multi-core compute capability is reinforced by strong scores across PassMark CPU tests and multi-threaded decompression. With substantial RAM-to-CPU ratios and bundled high-capacity local solid-state storage, this server is configured primarily for in-memory databases, large-scale Redis deployments, enterprise analytics, and intensive transactional database workloads.
